sections.title: Homepage Rebuild
items: Added a "What's New" callout with Characters and Artifacts grids, plus a plain "Character Guides" list linking to real guide pages, each tagged New/Buffed/Stellar.
Added this changelog as an in-page modal instead of a dead link, opened from a new header button.
Added Characters/Weapons quick-nav buttons to the header, next to Changelog and the Star Rail cross-link.

sections.title: Layout & Spacing
items: Increased and unified the sidebar-clearance margin across every page — including the combat pages, which had their own separate value until now.
Moved page-root spacing into a single shared .main-page class instead of each page re-declaring the same margin formula.

sections.title: Mobile Pass
items: Collapsed the header to icon-only buttons on narrow screens and hid the Characters/Weapons pills there, since the bottom nav bar already covers them.
Tightened padding and card sizing on the homepage callout boxes and this changelog modal for small viewports.

sections.title: Header & Theme Overhaul
items: Replaced the sticky header with a Snezhnaya-branded bar, and moved the site logo down to the footer.
Reworked light/dark mode into a purple-and-white / blue-and-black color system, with a sliding toggle switch instead of an icon button.

sections.title: Character & Weapon Pages
items: Switched character and weapon icons to a portrait 3:4 crop to keep every card the same size.
Migrated character data over to the Yatta API and hid elementless characters (like Manekin) from the roster.

sections.title: Layout Unification
items: Centralized page spacing behind shared CSS variables, so the sidebar and header gap stay consistent across every page.
Added a non-sticky footer with Discord/Twitter links and an intellectual property notice.

sections.title: Filter & Grid Styling
items: Retheme filter buttons and grid panels across the character, weapon, artifact, and enemy pages.
Fixed icon-tile filter buttons washing out in light mode by giving them a fixed dark purple background.
